page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines of type, a woodcut ornament between the lines of the imprint; no margin notes. Handwritten marks at top right (a cross-like mark and the number 2) are not transcribed.
page.notes: Printed as on the title page: "DI-vinæ" and "excuti-tur" are line-end hyphenations. The date reads MDCXXXIX in the print; the last numeral is partly worn, so "XXXIX" is a reading from the scan. The woodcut ornament between the place lines is omitted.
